data.body:
FINAL REPORT (rebar-debug protocol).

Problem: AGENTS.md (and CONTRIBUTING.md 2f) misstated the close precheck as requiring the MERGED rebar-ticket commit reachable from HEAD, unconditionally, and omitted transition --ref.

Proven root cause: docs contradict the implementation. _referencing_commit_exists (src/rebar/_commands/transition_close.py:149) runs git log with NO ref (:160-163) — any commit reachable from current HEAD, merged or not, referencing the ticket or any transitive descendant (:278-285) satisfies it; the check fires only when file_impact is recorded (:286) and the completion gate is on (:227-234), not on --force-close (:235) or a live replacement link (:256). Land-before-close is the Verified +1 policy, not the precheck.

Proof: direct read of the merged implementation at origin/main 286ab4f5ee2 (see RCA comment); RED-state greps confirmed the false phrase present in both files pre-fix and absent post-fix (incl. the line-wrapped CONTRIBUTING.md occurrence 'requires the\nmerged' that a single-line grep misses).

Test: docs-only change — oracle is the AC grep set (all RED pre-fix on AGENTS.md, GREEN post-fix) plus the 5 doc-reading test modules (49 passed), make lint and make typecheck (both 0). No executable behaviour changed, so no new unit test.

Fix: rewrote the AGENTS.md close bullet and CONTRIBUTING.md 2f to lead with the Verified +1 policy, state the real precheck mechanism (file_impact-conditional, HEAD-reachable, descendant subtree, merge status unchecked), keep the fast-forward recipe for the case it fixes, document transition --ref (verification/signature retarget only — does NOT narrow the referencing-commit scan), and preserve the shared-main-checkout warning sentences verbatim. Gerrit change 1356, MERGED as 758b550096 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved).

Siblings: construct sweep — grep for 'requires the merged' and 'cannot confirm the work landed' across all *.md: population was exactly the two fixed passages; templates/AGENTS.md and templates/rebar-usage.md never carried the claim. Parity: N/A (doc fix, no code surface).

Residual gaps: (1) the ticket AC's single-line grep '! grep -n "requires the merged" CONTRIBUTING.md' could never detect the wrapped occurrence — accepted: fix verified with a newline-tolerant check instead; (2) docs/plan-review-gate.md --ref section header moved to line 954 (plan cited 899-916) — accepted: pointer is by section title, not line number.

Replication: the original failure mode (agent concluding pre-land close is impossible / skipping --ref) is a doc-driven belief; the merged text now states the correct mechanism and names --ref, so the false default belief is removed at its source.
